Static.Global.Title: 9008 global backup and restore
Static.Global.Lead: Optional: back up the system before installing Linux, or skip to the action picker. With USB debugging authorized, Android can enter 9008 automatically; an existing 9008 connection also works. Use the long-edge USB-C port on all Y700 tablets.
Static.Global.AutoDetect: The tablet model is detected automatically on connect; no manual selection is needed.
Static.Global.PowerInitial: No power reading yet; live power cannot be read in 9008 mode. Keep the tablet sufficiently charged and external power connected before connecting.
Static.Global.BackupLead: Connect, verify the device, then back up read-only; no partition is written.
Static.Global.BackupBody: Use before installing Linux; backup stops if Linux partitions are detected. Saves A/B boot, system and firmware partitions, calibration data and partition tables. Android personal files are excluded. All userdata, rawdump and metadata partitions on every LUN are excluded. This backup is stored separately; the installation flow still backs up its required recovery material.
Static.Global.RestoreLead: Restores Android from this tablet’s own complete global backup; preparation only reads and verifies.
Static.Global.RestoreBody: Select this tablet’s own complete global backup. Preparation only reads and verifies. Confirmed recovery restores the backed-up system and partition tables, removes Linux and initializes Android, clearing Android and Linux personal files.
Static.Global.RestoreConsent: I have backed up my personal files and confirm that recovery clears Android and Linux data on this tablet.
Static.Global.OptionalNote: This step is optional: you can back up now or go straight to the action picker.
Static.Guide.Step2Caption: Open “Developer options” and turn on “USB debugging”.
Static.Guide.Step3Caption: Connect your Y700 tablet to the computer using its long-edge USB-C port, then allow USB debugging on the tablet.
Static.HelpStepAuthorize: 3 · Connect and allow: plug in a USB cable that can transfer data, unlock the tablet, choose “Allow” on the “Allow USB debugging?” prompt, then click “Detect tablet” below.
Static.HelpStepDeveloperOptions: 1 · Turn on developer options: open Settings → About tablet, find “Build number” (shown as “Software version” on some builds), tap it 7 times, enter your lock screen password when asked, until the tablet says developer mode is on.
Static.HelpStepUsbDebug: 2 · Turn on USB debugging: go back to Settings, search for and open “Developer options”, turn on “USB debugging”, then confirm the prompt on the tablet.
Static.HelpWarning: Menu names may vary by system version. If developer options are already on, you can start at step 2; USB debugging and BL unlocking are two separate settings.
Static.HomeLead: Each action opens its own step-by-step wizard, and you can come back here to choose another one at any time.
Static.InternalInstall.Backup.Coverage: Saves this tablet's A/B boot, partition tables and essential recovery material. Contents of userdata, rawdump, metadata and super are excluded; back up photos and app data yourself. Original PC backups stay unchanged. Installation places the required material in compressed form in the tablet's 2 GiB recovery area, excluding those contents even when reusing an older backup.
Static.InternalInstall.Backup.Title: Back up system recovery data
Static.InternalInstall.Backup.Warning: Back up personal files such as photos and app data yourself first. The system recovery data from this step is saved in the folder you choose on this PC — keep that backup.
Static.InternalInstall.Capacity.Lead: Space can only be allocated after the backup and the system package have been verified. The package chosen here is a 9008 direct-image installation package: the later preparation step expands and verifies its prebuilt partition images and generates and verifies device-specific A/B boot candidates. Legacy seed packages belong to the old route and cannot be used for this internal direct route.
Static.InternalInstall.Capacity.Rule: Android user data needs at least 16 GiB; Linux needs at least 64 GiB in total (including its separate 1 GiB Linux boot area); the tail recovery partition is fixed at 2 GiB for the compressed system recovery backup.
Static.InternalInstall.Capacity.StatusWa: Space can only be allocated after the backup is done and the system package is verified.
Static.InternalInstall.Capacity.Title: Allocate space
Static.InternalInstall.Check.Lead: After you start the check, the app restarts the tablet into Fastboot to verify the bootloader lock and update state, then returns to Android and confirms it is the same tablet. Keep the long-edge USB-C port connected and allow USB debugging when the tablet asks.

Static.PackageLead: Choose a unified archive: data shared by every model is stored only once, and the app automatically selects the components for the confirmed device model. Supported formats: ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR, tar.gz/tgz, tar.xz/txz, tar.zst/tzst and tar.bz2/tbz2. For a split archive, put every volume in the same directory and choose the first volume (.001 or .part1.rar/.part01.rar). Legacy package folders can still be entered directly.
